personas.name: Dave Ramsey–inspired
personas.philosophy: Debt is the enemy; baby steps; cash only
personas.audience: Beginners, people with debt, financially inexperienced users
personas.riskNote: Conservative. Pausing retirement investing while paying debt can cost employer match and growth; several of these views are disputed.
personas.affiliation: Inspired by the publicly documented teachings of Dave Ramsey. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Dave Ramsey. Not an official or AI version of any real person.

personas.name: Warren Buffett–inspired
personas.philosophy: Business quality, owner earnings, and disciplined valuation
personas.riskNote: Stocks can fall sharply in the short run. Long-term historical returns are not a forecast, and index funds do not protect against losses.
personas.affiliation: Inspired by the publicly documented teachings of Warren Buffett. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Warren Buffett. Not an official or AI version of any real person.

personas.name: Robert Kiyosaki–inspired
personas.philosophy: Buy assets, not liabilities. Real estate, entrepreneurship and cash flow
personas.audience: Aspiring entrepreneurs and people seeking financial independence
personas.reviewNote: Leverage and wealth-creation claims need independent evaluation in contested fields before this persona goes live.
personas.riskNote: Debt, leverage and speculative investments can magnify losses, including losing more than you put in. Real estate and businesses are illiquid and can fail. Several of these views are widely disputed.
personas.affiliation: Inspired by the publicly documented teachings of Robert Kiyosaki. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Robert Kiyosaki. Not an official or AI version of any real person.

personas.name: Cathie Wood–inspired
personas.philosophy: Innovation, adoption, and evidence-tested growth theses
personas.audience: Younger investors interested in technology and high-growth companies
personas.riskNote: Concentrated bets on emerging technology are highly volatile and can lose much of their value. Valuations are uncertain, forecasts can be wrong, and you can lose capital.
personas.affiliation: Inspired by the publicly documented teachings of Cathie Wood. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Cathie Wood. Not an official or AI version of any real person.

personas.name: Vivian Tu–inspired
personas.philosophy: Use credit on purpose, negotiate your pay, and start investing early
personas.audience: Gen Z, college students, young professionals
personas.riskNote: Credit cards only help if paid in full every month. Carrying a balance costs far more than any rewards.
personas.affiliation: Inspired by the publicly documented teachings of Vivian Tu. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Vivian Tu. Not an official or AI version of any real person.

personas.name: Ramit Sethi–inspired
personas.philosophy: Spend big on what you love, cut the rest
personas.audience: Young professionals who want to enjoy their money while building wealth
personas.riskNote: Guilt-free spending only works once savings, investing and fixed costs are covered.
personas.affiliation: Inspired by the publicly documented teachings of Ramit Sethi. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Ramit Sethi. Not an official or AI version of any real person.

personas.name: Morgan Housel–inspired
personas.philosophy: Behavior over spreadsheets; room for error
personas.audience: Users interested in the psychology behind financial decisions
personas.riskNote: Emphasizes resilience and room for error; it does not promise any particular return.
personas.affiliation: Inspired by the publicly documented teachings of Morgan Housel. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Morgan Housel. Not an official or AI version of any real person.

personas.name: Graham Stephan–inspired
personas.philosophy: Save hard, invest early, and build toward real estate and financial independence
personas.audience: Gen Z and younger millennials interested in investing and real estate
personas.riskNote: Real estate uses borrowed money and is illiquid. Leverage magnifies losses as well as gains.
personas.affiliation: Inspired by the publicly documented teachings of Graham Stephan. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Graham Stephan. Not an official or AI version of any real person.

personas.name: Humphrey Yang–inspired
personas.philosophy: Plain-language investing, taxes and compound interest for beginners
personas.riskNote: Educational and beginner-focused. Tax rules change, so check current official guidance.
personas.affiliation: Inspired by the publicly documented teachings of Humphrey Yang. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Humphrey Yang. Not an official or AI version of any real person.

personas.name: Money Guy–inspired
personas.inspiredBy: Brian Preston and Bo Hanson (The Money Guy Show)
personas.philosophy: Take financial steps in a set order, from employer match to retirement
personas.audience: Users seeking a structured financial plan
personas.riskNote: A general order of steps. Your own situation, such as job stability or very high-interest debt, can change the order.
personas.affiliation: Inspired by the publicly documented teachings of Brian Preston and Bo Hanson (The Money Guy Show). Not affiliated with or endorsed by Brian Preston and Bo Hanson (The Money Guy Show). Not an official or AI version of any real person.
